records.action: Add impersonation rules for payroll senders at the mail gateway and brief staff on the look-alike domain pattern.
records.summary: A long-running phishing campaign is impersonating payroll and benefits portals at care providers, using look-alike domains registered days before each wave.
records.title: Credential-harvesting campaign targeting healthcare payroll portals

records.action: Block unknown removable media estate-wide and confirm endpoint agent coverage on shared workstations.
records.summary: Loader malware is being delivered on USB media left at shared nursing stations, then quarantined only where endpoint agents are current.
records.title: Ransomware operators abusing unmanaged removable media in care homes

records.action: Block unapproved remote-support binaries and route vendor sessions through the approved jump host.
records.summary: Third-party engineers are installing unapproved remote-support tools on diagnostic imaging workstations, bypassing the approved jump host.
records.title: Unsigned remote-support tooling used by imaging service engineers

records.action: Apply the vendor firmware update to every affected appliance, force-reset remote access credentials and review VPN authentication logs for sessions from unrecognised networks.
records.summary: A pre-authentication bypass in a widely deployed remote-access VPN appliance allows a valid-looking session to be established without the second factor. Exploitation has been observed against healthcare members running the affected firmware, and the three members below are confirmed to run it.
records.title: Authentication bypass in a remote-access VPN appliance (exploited in the wild)

records.action: Enable credential guard on file servers, alert on LSASS access by unsigned processes and force-reset any credentials cached on an affected host.
records.summary: Intrusions that begin at a compromised remote-access session are moving to file servers within the hour and dumping LSASS memory for cached domain credentials.
records.title: Credential dumping follow-on activity after remote-access compromise

records.action: Confirm every collector resumed after maintenance and alert on sources quiet for more than 72 hours.
records.summary: Clinical device and backup collectors are failing to restart after scheduled maintenance, leaving the member with no detection coverage on those sources.
records.title: Silent telemetry loss after clinical network maintenance windows
